metadata.title: Binary Search Warm-up
metadata.description: Solve a quick problem to keep your DSA streak alive.

data.explanation: An array stores elements of the same data type in contiguous memory.

data.questionText: What is the index of the first element in an array?
data.explanation: Most programming languages use zero-based indexing.

data.questionText: How are elements stored in an array?
data.explanation: Array elements occupy consecutive memory locations.

data.questionText: Which operation is fastest in an array?
What is the time complexity of accessing an element by index?
data.explanation: Direct index access does not depend on array size.
